bibliographic.title: Face Your Fears
bibliographic.author: Shawn Sijnstra
bibliographic.description:
Face Your Fears was developed as part of the PunyJam #2 PunyInform Interactive Fiction competition.

It's a small interactive fiction, built around the Jam theme relating to the main character having at least one phobia which needed to be overcome. For more details on PunyInform and the game jam, check out https://itch.io/jam/punyjam-2

The game revolves around a short adventure exploring a number of phobias, culminating a really bad pun.
